# options
message(STATUS "Building jsonui-app examples: ${JSONUI_APPLICATION}")

if (WIN32)
#! [appicon_windows]
    set(app_icon_resource_windows "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/jsonui-app.rc")
    qt_add_executable(jsonui-app main.cpp ${app_icon_resource_windows})
#! [appicon_windows]
elseif (APPLE)
#! [appicon_macOS]
    # The MACOSX_BUNDLE_ICON_FILE variable is added to the Info.plist
    # generated by CMake. This variable contains the .icns file name,
    # without the path.
    set(MACOSX_BUNDLE_ICON_FILE jsonui-app.icns)

    # And the following tells CMake where to find and install the file itself.
    set(app_icon_macos "jsonui-app.icns")
    set_source_files_properties(${app_icon_macos} PROPERTIES
           MACOSX_PACKAGE_LOCATION "resources")

    qt_add_executable(jsonui-app MACOSX_BUNDLE main.cpp ${app_icon_macos})

    set_target_properties(jsonui-app PROPERTIES
        # WIN32_EXECUTABLE TRUE
        MACOSX_BUNDLE_GUI_IDENTIFIER ch.psi.gems3
        MACOSX_BUNDLE_COPYRIGHT  "Copyright (c) 2026 GEMS Development Team"
        MACOSX_BUNDLE_ICON_FILE jsonui-app.icns
        MACOSX_BUNDLE_INFO_STRING "jsonui-app"
        MACOSX_BUNDLE_BUNDLE_VERSION ${PROJECT_VERSION}
        MACOSX_BUNDLE_SHORT_VERSION_STRING ${PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR}.${PROJECT_VERSION_MINOR}
        MACOSX_BUNDLE TRUE
    )

#! [appicon_macOS]
else()
    qt_add_executable(jsonui-app main.cpp)
    #install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/jsonui-app.desktop DESTINATION share/applications)
    #install(FILES ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/jsonui-app.png DESTINATION share/icons)
endif()

target_sources(jsonui-app
    PRIVATE
        JSONUITestMainWindow.h
        JSONUITestMainWindow.cpp
)

if(${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID} STREQUAL MSVC)
  target_link_libraries (jsonui-app PRIVATE jsonui jsonio::jsonio)
else()
  target_link_libraries (jsonui-app PRIVATE jsonui jsonio::jsonio)
endif()

install(TARGETS jsonui-app
    BUNDLE  DESTINATION .
    RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}
)

# Deploy the application
if(DEPLOY_APP)

  if(DEFINED ENV{CONDA_PREFIX})
    message(STATUS "conda path: $ENV{CONDA_PREFIX}")

    if(${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID} STREQUAL MSVC)

        set(dll_path "C:/Miniconda/envs/GEMSGUI/Library/bin")
        message(STATUS "dll path: ${dll_path}")
        #install(FILES "${dll_path}/GEMS3K.dll" DESTINATION bin)
    endif()
  endif()

qt_generate_deploy_app_script(
    TARGET jsonui-app
    OUTPUT_SCRIPT deploy_script
    NO_TRANSLATIONS
    NO_UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM_ERROR
)
install(SCRIPT ${deploy_script})

endif()
